quorum task start HEX-042-new-spec created worktrees/HEX-042-new-spec on branch ai/HEX-042-new-spec at d4348f2, then failed to initialize 04-implementation-log.yaml because it derives task_id from the directory slug 'HEX-042-new-spec', which does not match the schema pattern ^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+(-[a-z])?$. This is pre-existing CLI behaviour for this repository's slug convention: none of HEX-030..HEX-041 has a 04-implementation-log.yaml either, and every one of them completed. Worktree and branch are correct; 07-trace.json was written by the blueprint phase instead of by the CLI.

00-spec invariant 5 places the pre-execution hold inside procesar_evento. The blueprint places it one level below, in ProcesadorDeInferencia::procesar immediately before self.proveedor.generar, leaving motor.rs untouched and forbidden. Observable order is unchanged. Rationale: co-location with the component that owns the provider makes AC-2 structural, and motor-level placement would gate the 17 Motor::nuevo call sites across 7 ProcesadorDeEco test files that assert a reply is sent, forcing ~19 unrelated test edits. Recorded for the human to confirm or overrule; the spec was NOT modified.

adr-0005-contabilidad-dos-fases is decided to be BORN in this task rather than in the reconciliation task (task 8), resolving the open decision that 00-spec non_goals delegated to the blueprint phase. The irreversible design commitments (opaque units, verdict-not-error, single transaction, fail-closed accounting, minimum-one-unit floor) are all made here; an ADR written after the mechanism ships would document a fait accompli. docs/adr/README.md line 16 already carries a placeholder row marked 'Tomada en el PRD, por formalizar' and must flip to Vigente in the same commit.
